data.repair_issues: Create a repair issue when a tunnel runs an outdated cloudflared

outdated_cloudflared.title: cloudflared on tunnel {tunnel} is outdated
outdated_cloudflared.description:
The connector of Cloudflare Tunnel **{tunnel}** runs cloudflared {installed}, the latest release is {latest}.

Update cloudflared on the host running this tunnel. The issue disappears once the connector reports the new version. You can ignore it to skip this release; the update entity shows the release notes.

Repair issues can be turned off in the integration options.
